reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the trace boron grain-boundary strengthening strategy reported for MoNbTaW (P1) to the NbTaHfTiZrV0.5 alloy (P3), which is a straightforward application of a known intervention to a different alloy without a new mechanistic rationale or integration of conflicting evidence. The core idea is essentially the future work implied by P1.
